column1: # GLSL shaders GameMaker puts together at run time (the Mac host's DM_GL_CAPTURE, booting to the title screen): the runner builds each variant from its own templates and the
# game's shader files, so no game file holds them; <key>.vert / <key>.frag, key = sha256(GLSL)[:16]. The NSP script's GL shader capture runs
# until every one here is captured; gl_shaders.py translates the capture with the RomFS (the sources are GLSL ES 1.00 without a #version line)
